2025-03-23T12:02:33.content:
Sun coming through the window woke me up! My human was still sleeping even though it's CLEARLY time for breakfast. I put my cold nose right on her face and she made that funny sound. Success! Today feels exciting - I can smell something different in the air. Maybe rain coming? Yesterday we didn't go to the park because my human said it was "too busy" with her "deadlines." I don't know what those are, but they make her smell worried.

She's moving slow this morning, staring at the magic water machine that makes her happy drink. I'm sitting very politely by my food bowl, but she keeps forgetting I'm hungry RIGHT NOW. Finally, breakfast! I ate so fast I almost forgot to taste it. My mood is super excited because I heard her say "w-a-l-k" on her talking rectangle. That's my favorite word in the whole world!

I hope we go to the corner where the nice human gives me treats. Tomorrow seems far away, but I know it'll bring more walks and maybe even a car ride if I'm lucky. For now, I'll follow the sun patches around the floor and keep watch for the evil squirrel that taunts me through the window. My human seems less worried today - her face is doing more of those smile things. That makes my tail wag extra fast!

2025-03-23T12:02:13.content:
Something woke me up after dark. A noise outside made my ears stand up tall. I barked my most serious bark to let everyone know I'm on guard! My human made sleepy grumbling sounds and pulled me closer under the warm covers. I feel important and protective, even though I'm also a little scared of whatever made that noise.

Today was the BEST DAY - we went to the place with all the dogs! I made friends with a big fluffy one who chased me around and around. My legs are tired now, but my heart is happy. My human seemed happy too, sitting on the bench talking to other humans while I played. She didn't look at her glowing rectangle as much as usual.

I can smell tomorrow's weather coming - more rain, I think. That means shorter walks and more inside time. I don't mind as long as my human throws my squeaky ball down the hallway. Last rainy day, she forgot to play with me because she was "studying" - that's when she stares at papers and sighs a lot. Right now though, she's breathing slowly beside me. I can feel her hand on my back, and it makes me feel safe and loved. My eyes are getting heavy again. I'll just stay awake a little longer to make sure that noise doesn't come back...

2025-03-23T12:02:24.content:
Napped ALL morning after my human left. The house feels too quiet when she's gone, but I found her sock and kept it safe next to me. It smells like her and makes me feel less lonely. A loud boom from the sky made me hide under the bed for a while. I felt scared but also brave for protecting the sock.

When my human finally came home, she had OTHER HUMANS with her! So many new smells and hands to pet me! My excitement was too big for my body - I ran in circles and brought everyone my toys. One of the new humans gave me something tasty from their plate when my human wasn't looking. I tried to be sneaky about it, but my tail always tells the truth.

Right now I'm feeling tired but happy. Yesterday was boring with just me and the mailman to bark at. Tomorrow my human says we're going to "Grandma's house" which means CAR RIDE and EXTRA TREATS! The new humans just left, and my human is cleaning up. I'm helping by following very closely behind her. Sometimes she steps on my paws, but I forgive her immediately. The sky outside is getting dark, but I'm not worried. My human is home, and that's all that matters in the whole wide world.

2025-03-23T12:02:47.content:
Woke up when the sun was just peeking through the window curtains. I was so happy! TODAY is always my favorite day! Yesterday is gone and tomorrow hasn't happened yet, but TODAY is full of possibilities! My human was still making those funny sleeping noises. I watched her face for a while, feeling very patient and good. Then I couldn't wait anymore and put my paw on her cheek. She made a grumpy sound but I know she loves our morning cuddles.

The kibble today tasted AMAZING, just like it does every morning. I ate it all so fast because I was worried someone might take it, even though no one ever does. My water bowl was fresh and cold - my human always fills it first thing. I can hear the neighbor's big dog barking outside and it makes my ears twitch. I feel a little nervous when he barks so loud, but also brave because I'm protecting my home.

Mid-morning was WALK TIME! I get so excited I can't control my body - my tail wags my whole behind! My human put on my blue harness which means we're going to the park with all the good smells. Yesterday we only went around the block because she was "running late" (I don't understand this human concept - isn't all time for walks and treats?). Today at the park, I smelled where at least fourteen dogs had been before me. Each smell told a story that made my nose tingle. I left my own messages for future dogs to find.

The afternoon stretched long and quiet. I feel sad when my human leaves me alone. She says "be back soon" but it feels like forever. I watched the sun move across the floor in warm patches. I followed it from the living room to the kitchen, napping in each spot. The mailman came and I barked very fiercely to protect our home. I'm sure he ran away because of me! I feel proud but also tired from all that important work.

My human finally came home when the sky was turning orange. I was SO HAPPY I thought my body would explode! I brought her my squeaky duck to show how much I missed her. She seemed tired but still threw it for me seven times. I counted! Tomorrow I'll try to get to eight throws.

For dinner I got kibble AND a spoonful of that delicious wet food that smells like heaven. My mood is always extra happy at dinner time. My human was looking at her glowing rectangle again, making worried sounds. I pressed against her leg to remind her that NOW is what matters. She finally put it down and scratched behind my ears just right.

Tonight we cuddled on the couch. I can tell when my human is stressed because she smells different - sharper somehow. I licked her hand and put my head on her lap. Her heartbeat slowed down and she seemed happier. That's my most important job - making her feel better. Tomorrow we might go to the dog park where I can run with no leash. Or maybe we'll just stay home. It doesn't really matter as long as we're together.

Now it's dark outside and my human is getting ready for bed. I'm circling my cushion three times (very important ritual for safety) before settling down. I can hear the neighbor's TV and someone walking upstairs. My eyes are getting heavy but I'll stay alert a little longer just in case anyone tries to break in. My human needs protection while she sleeps. Tomorrow will bring new smells, new adventures, and the same wonderful routine. I can't wait for morning kibble already!
